name: Gradle Maven-layout repositories
client: Gradle 9.8.2 on Temurin 27; optional JFrog CLI 2.131.0 wrapper
auth: Use an access or reference token as the HTTP Basic password, with AW_USER equal to its subject. The subject needs read permission for installation and deploy permission for publication on the selected repository; token scopes cannot exceed that identity. The same clients also accept a user password when Basic password authentication is enabled. Use HTTPS.
fresh_home: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.
prerequisites: Use a gradle repository with repoLayoutRef=maven-2-default, since maven-publish writes Maven paths.
The checksum-verified Gradle distribution in the pinned Maven client image.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
export GRADLE_USER_HOME="$AW_WORK/gradle-home"
export AW_REPO_URL="$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO"
configure.note: Use the pinned Gradle executable. Set repository layout maven-2-default for this Maven publication/resolution recipe. Credentials are read from exported AW_USER/AW_TOKEN. Separate producer and consumer homes when proving an independent download.

publish.note: Publish to a local or one-node federated repository. Remote repositories are read-through caches; select the local deployment member when reading through a virtual.

steps.note: Producer build.gradle; settings.gradle must set rootProject.name = "widget". Place the producer sources/resources under src/main. The endpoint must use HTTPS.
Run from the producer project. This is direct Gradle publication; JFrog build-info integration remains a separately recorded informational lane.

install.note: Select a local, remote, virtual or one-node federated repository with read permission. Dependencies must also be available through that repository.

steps.note: Consumer build.gradle in a separate empty project; create settings.gradle with a consumer name. Use a new GRADLE_USER_HOME and project directory.
Checks the configured repository for the requested module; no mavenLocal() repository is added.

limitations: The historical gradle-default Ivy-style layout needs a different resolver/publication pattern and is not represented by these commands.
JFrog CLI gradle integration is informational; direct Gradle recipe verification is a required native acceptance scenario.
The isolated test server uses HTTP loopback and explicitly enables allowInsecureProtocol there; production snippets require HTTPS.
